purpose: Teach: 鳳/鞘/英字/天秤/死語/有色/太もも/気密

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、神話の鳳凰研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on mythological phoenix birds, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, affirming opening. Genuine curiosity. Steady pace. Slight lift at the end—seeking confirmation, not testing. The tone of a teacher who has read your work and wants to see you acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、日本刀の鞘職人研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on Japanese sword scabbard craftsmen.
lines.style: Measured, careful correction. Slight self-consciousness—he knows this is a different topic entirely. Steady eye contact implied. Not defensive, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英字新聞の読解力研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered reading comprehension of English newspapers in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Slower tempo. She's noticing something. A half-smile in the voice—is this playful or is she testing him? The ambiguity is intentional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、天秤量りの精度研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually focused on precision measurements in mechanical scales.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest correction. Slight hesitation before answering—he's aware something is off but answering truthfully anyway. Not frustrated, just honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 死語化する若者言葉を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined dying slang among young people, didn't you?
lines.style: More animated now. Slight tilt forward in the voice. She's catching on to something and her engagement sharpens. Friendly but with an edge of deliberate interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、有色金属の精錬史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, mine was actually on the history of non-ferrous metal refining.
lines.style: Still measured, still earnest. A beat of quietness before the answer—he understands now that something is being tested. Not embarrassed, but aware. Direct and honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、太もも筋トレの効率研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you researched the efficiency of thigh muscle training, right?
lines.style: Lighter tone now, almost bemused. She's definitely playing with him, but not unkindly. A knowing quality—she's about to reveal something. Steady, observant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、気密性建築の換気研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, mine covered ventilation systems in airtight buildings.
lines.style: Quiet, direct answer. He's given up correcting. A small exhaustion in the voice—patient, resigned, slightly self-aware. The final answer of someone who understands the game.
